definition: Motor control algorithms determine drive commands that make an electric motor meet targets such as position, speed or torque.
entry_text: Motor control algorithms determine drive commands that make an electric motor meet targets such as position, speed or torque.
example: A controller adjusts drive commands to maintain a conveyor's requested speed when its load changes.
label: Motor control algorithms
sense_note: This is the engineering sense, not computational models of biological motor control.
